newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown -3.40 pct vs mark/dlr basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown -3.40 pct vs mark/dlr basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 30.673 to the dollar after Wednesday's fixing at 30.926, and at 18.177 to the mark from 18.141.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of -3.40 percent, after a deviation of -3.58 on Wednesday.
During the minute at which the central bank calculated today's fixing, the crown was trading on the interbank market at -3.54.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (0940 GMT), and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
